digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD — CodeQL workflow scheduling
propositions: CodeQL workflow cadence changed from weekly (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) to restore coverage parity with the pre-mirror push-on-main behavior.
The 6-hourly tick was specified as the replacement for push-on-main CI; leaving CodeQL weekly silently reduced coverage of newly-landed code from per-commit to up to 7 days.
CodeQL has no push trigger and must remain schedule-only, so it cannot join the _SIX_HOURLY test tuple wholesale and requires a separate schedule-only 6-hourly cohort in the test.
The four 6-hourly lanes (test, optionality, verify-identity, codeql) use distinct off-the-hour minutes (41, 47, 53, 35 respectively) to avoid GitHub scheduler congestion.
The stale '28x cost increase' rationale in the codeql.yml header comment was removed because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and GitHub Actions minutes are free.
